description: Look up domains on Semrush's public website pages. Returns one row per domain with Authority Score, visits, organic and paid traffic, backlinks, rank, competitors, and keywords. Reads run 20 seconds apart. Semrush has a public page for some domains only.

domains.description: Domains or URLs to look up, such as stripe.com. Semrush publishes a page for some domains only: in a test of 30, 15 had one.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_domains.description: Text number from 1 to 1000. Default 100. Reads run 20 seconds apart, so 100 domains take about 33 minutes. Set the run timeout to fit.

name: get_semrush_domain_metrics
title: Get Semrush domain metrics
